The '''GRS-1''' was a [[Snare rifle/Legends|snare rifle]] used by the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], among others. It caused no damage on impact but instead fired a [[Shockstun mist|shock/stun spray]] and a liquid [[Spraynet/Legends|spraynet]] to immobilize the stunned target. Manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], this weapon required two cartridges to operate; a shockstun mist canister and a liquid spraynet dispenser. The cartridges could fire up to twelve shots before replacement.<ref name="HtOHH" />
